title: Guide: VTC implementer's guide to Chat delegation
description: Write jmap-vtc-chat-delegation-guide.md for VTC implementers leveraging JMAP Chat. Covers: server auto-creating Chats for calls, in-call text chat via bound chatId, live captions as Chat ephemeral events (VTC→Chat WSS), in-call emoji reactions via Chat Reactions, lobby chat for waiting participants, ChatStreamEnable with dataTypes vtc, presence integration (busy during call), notification coordination (muting chat notifications during active call).
